ticket_input.title: Login throws an error when password field is blank
ticket_input.description: If a user submits the sign-in form and leaves the password box empty, the server responds with an internal error instead of a clean validation message.

ticket_input.title: Listing shows one fewer page than it should
ticket_input.description: On the results listing, when the number of records isn't an exact multiple of the page size, the last page of records is missing from the page navigation.

ticket_input.title: Uploading files named with accents breaks
ticket_input.description: Users report that files whose names include accented or non-English characters refuse to upload and produce an encoding-related crash.

ticket_input.title: Product page errors out when there are no reviews yet
ticket_input.description: Opening a brand-new product that has not received any ratings causes the page to crash while calculating the average score.

ticket_input.title: Exported spreadsheet dates are in the wrong order of fields
ticket_input.description: When exporting data, the date column comes out as month/day/year, but our downstream tools expect the year-first international format and reject the file.

ticket_input.title: Report screen crashes when there is no data
ticket_input.description: If a report is generated for a period that contains no records, the report builder throws an error instead of showing an empty report.

ticket_input.title: API responses sometimes parsed as plain text by clients
ticket_input.description: Some client applications fail to read our API output correctly, treating the returned data as text rather than structured data, which breaks their parsing.

ticket_input.title: Server memory keeps climbing over time
ticket_input.description: On long-running instances, memory usage grows steadily until the process becomes unstable. It seems related to image preview handling that never releases old entries.

ticket_input.title: Contact form sends users to a missing page
ticket_input.description: After a visitor submits the contact form, instead of a thank-you page they land on a not-found error page.

ticket_input.title: View counts are lower than actual traffic
ticket_input.description: Under busy periods, the recorded number of page views is noticeably lower than the real number of visits, as if some increments are being lost.

ticket_input.title: Customers occasionally receive the same email twice
ticket_input.description: When the mail system is slow, some recipients get duplicate copies of the same notification, apparently because the send is retried.

ticket_input.title: Invoice totals are sometimes a fraction of a penny off
ticket_input.description: Finance reports that some invoice totals show tiny rounding discrepancies, for example a long trailing decimal instead of a clean amount.

ticket_input.title: Turning something on turns it off
ticket_input.description: Our operations team says that when they switch a certain capability on in the settings, it behaves as if switched off, and vice versa. Very confusing.

ticket_input.title: The system just hangs forever sometimes
ticket_input.description: Occasionally an operation never finishes and the process appears frozen. It happens when an underlying step keeps failing and something keeps trying again endlessly.

ticket_input.title: Security team flagged a redirect concern
ticket_input.description: Our security reviewers raised that a redirect feature might let an attacker send users to an outside site or tamper with response headers because the target isn't checked.

ticket_input.title: Sign-in intermittently errors for some submissions
ticket_input.description: A portion of sign-in attempts fail with a server error rather than a friendly message; it appears to correlate with how the credentials were entered.

ticket_input.title: App won't start, complains about a missing secret
ticket_input.description: In the production environment the application refuses to boot, reporting that a required secret key value has not been provided.

ticket_input.title: Cannot connect to the database on the usual port
ticket_input.description: The application reports a connection refused error when trying to reach the database, even though the database service itself appears to be running.

ticket_input.title: Stylesheets and scripts missing in production
ticket_input.description: The site loads unstyled in production because the CSS and JavaScript files return not-found, though everything is fine in development.

ticket_input.title: Frontend blocked from calling the API
ticket_input.description: The browser prevents our web frontend from calling the backend API, citing a cross-origin restriction.

ticket_input.title: Stack traces visible to end users
ticket_input.description: Users are seeing detailed error pages with stack traces in production, which is a security concern; debug output appears to be switched on.

ticket_input.title: Logs filling the disk very quickly
ticket_input.description: The server disk keeps filling up with an enormous volume of log output, far more than expected, suggesting the logging verbosity is set too high.

ticket_input.title: Users logged out after a very short time
ticket_input.description: People are being signed out almost immediately after logging in, as though the session lifetime is set far too low.

ticket_input.title: Outgoing email not being sent
ticket_input.description: No outbound emails are being delivered from one environment; the mail server host setting appears unreachable from within the container.

ticket_input.title: Requests rejected far too aggressively
ticket_input.description: Legitimate users are hitting a limit and being blocked after only a handful of requests, as if the rate limit threshold is misconfigured very low.

ticket_input.title: Caching seems to be doing nothing
ticket_input.description: Performance is poor because caching does not appear to take effect; the cache lifetime may be set to zero, disabling it entirely.

ticket_input.title: Everything is an hour off
ticket_input.description: Timestamps across the application seem shifted by a fixed amount, which the team suspects is an environment time-zone setting rather than a code issue.

ticket_input.title: Big valid files get rejected
ticket_input.description: Uploads that should be allowed are being refused for being too large, even though they are within the intended limit, pointing at a size setting.

ticket_input.title: New deployment can't be reached at its address
ticket_input.description: After deploying, the service is unreachable at the expected domain; the allowed-hosts or base-URL configuration may be pointing at the wrong place.

ticket_input.title: Background jobs never run
ticket_input.description: Scheduled or asynchronous jobs are not executing at all; it looks like the worker or thread configuration might be set to zero.

ticket_input.title: Admin can't open the admin dashboard
ticket_input.description: A user who has been given the administrator role still receives a forbidden error when trying to open the admin dashboard.

ticket_input.title: New starters can't log in on day one
ticket_input.description: Newly created employee accounts cannot sign in, receiving an account-not-active message, even though the accounts clearly exist.

ticket_input.title: Password reset emails never arrive
ticket_input.description: People requesting a password reset never receive the email, so they remain locked out of their accounts.

ticket_input.title: Valid API key keeps getting rejected
ticket_input.description: A client reports their API key, which should be valid, is being refused with an unauthorized response on every request.

ticket_input.title: Read-only account can change data
ticket_input.description: An account meant to be read-only is able to edit and delete records, which is a privilege escalation concern.

ticket_input.title: Locked out after a few wrong tries
ticket_input.description: Users are being locked out of their accounts after only a couple of failed login attempts, which seems too strict.

ticket_input.title: Single sign-on loops back to login
ticket_input.description: When using single sign-on, users are bounced back to the login screen in a loop instead of being signed in.

ticket_input.title: Group members don't inherit group permissions
ticket_input.description: Users added to a permission group do not receive the group's access rights, so they still can't reach resources they should.

ticket_input.title: Removed user can still do things
ticket_input.description: An account that was deactivated appears to still be able to call the API, as though the revocation didn't fully take effect.

ticket_input.title: People see data that isn't theirs
ticket_input.description: After signing in, some users briefly see information belonging to a different tenant or account, a serious isolation concern.
